instruction: Demonstrate the use of ranges and sequences in PascalABC.NET with the following operations: create a character range 'a' to 'z', check if 3 is in range 1..5, iterate through range 1..10, create an array and hash set from range 1..5, and calculate squares of numbers 1 to 9.
Create and display a dictionary from an array of key-value pairs in PascalABC.NET.
Create and use a string dictionary and integer list in PascalABC.NET. Add 'cat' translation for 'кошка' to dictionary and add numbers 2 and 3 to the list.
Solve the Cauchy problem for orbital motion using RKF45 method in PascalABC.NET with NumLibABC library.
Create a digital clock using GraphABC and System libraries in PascalABC.NET that displays current time in HH:MM:SS format and updates every second.
Create graphics with random points, shapes and text using Coords library in PascalABC.NET.
Draw points with labels and calculate distances between them using Coords library in PascalABC.NET.
Count occurrences of number 1 in an array using CountOf method in PascalABC.NET.
Demonstrate covariance with sequences of different types in PascalABC.NET.
Create a console drawing application using Crt library in PascalABC.NET with cursor movement and color changing functionality.
Display all CRT color combinations in PascalABC.NET.
Create a 3D cube grid using Graph3D library in PascalABC.NET.
Create various graphical shapes and text using GraphWPF library in PascalABC.NET with save/load functionality.
Work with DateTime objects in PascalABC.NET: get current date, add/subtract time, create specific date, and calculate time intervals.
Parse date string, check for leap year, and format DateTime to different string representations in PascalABC.NET.
Measure code execution time using DateTime in PascalABC.NET.
Solve system of linear equations using Decomp from NumLibABC library in PascalABC.NET.
Create a game where squares must be deleted in numerical order using WPFObjects library in PascalABC.NET.
Display letters/digits and punctuation characters from ASCII range 0-127 in PascalABC.NET.
